summary: Backend regression testing of Cherry Tree Agency /api/leads endpoint after LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL change. All 7 pytest cases passed: happy path POST, GET listing (newest-first + created lead present), invalid email 422, missing phone 422, missing many required 422, and log inspection confirming NO new 'Webhook forward failed' / ObjectId serialization errors after our POST. The webhook forward runs in a background asyncio task and did not produce any error entry. Existing single occurrence in backend.err.log is from 2026-09-17 (pre-fix) and is unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: asyncio.create_task on a fire-and-forget coroutine (line 119) discards the task reference; if it errors, the exception is only visible via a warning inside _forward_to_webhook. Consider keeping a strong ref (e.g., add to a set) to avoid the task being GC'd early on some event loops, though in practice FastAPI keeps the loop alive.
Lead model exposes owner PII (email/phone) in GET /api/leads with no auth. If this endpoint is meant only for owner viewing, add auth or restrict.
Website field has no URL validation; accepts any string.
seed_data_creation: Single test lead posted with email qa-webhook-test@example.com; deleted from Mongo via session-scoped autouse cleanup fixture. Verified count=0 post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_leads_api.py captures the backend.err.log offset at module import to check ONLY new log entries (a stale 'Webhook forward failed' at line 146 from 2026-09-17 pre-fix is expected and ignored). Cleanup fixture removes leads by email. Keep live POSTs minimal because /api/leads forwards to the real LeadConnector webhook (cbf1d880 URL).
rca of the issue: No issue found. Prior ObjectId serialization bug remains fixed: server.py inserts dict(payload) into Mongo and forwards the pre-insert clean payload; the Mongo _id injection therefore never touches the webhook body. New LeadConnector webhook URL is reachable (returned within timeout, no exception logged).
